title: Concept: Argo CD GitOps console disclosed
description: The Argo CD UI is served at this endpoint, so the deployment console with its application inventory and sync controls is reachable.
applicability: Responses served by an Argo CD server.
risk: The console maps clusters and deployment sources, and can trigger a sync where permissions allow it, which is a path to running attacker-chosen manifests; MEDIUM because the page alone does not prove a sync is accepted.
